resources.string: Talaria could not safely read the saved connection data. Nothing was erased. Retry after restarting or copy the non-secret diagnostics for support.
The device can no longer decrypt the saved connections. Nothing was erased. You can copy diagnostics before choosing the destructive reset.
Reset removes only saved Hermes connections and their encrypted credentials. Settings, chat cache, and car-host trust are not removed. You will need to add connections again.
This permanently removes every saved Hermes connection and credential from this device. It does not erase other Talaria data. This cannot be undone.
